prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a wide landscape atmospheric background for an elegant warm dreamy editorial personal portfolio website. Exactly TWO ivory wax candles grouped on the right third of the frame, their tops clearly visible. One candle is lit with a small delicate amber flame gently leaning sideways toward the second candle. The second candle is extinguished: dark wick, no flame, faint wisp of smoke. A quiet suggestion of warmth reaching toward the unlit candle. Soft-focus photographic realism, delicate film grain, cream, pale caramel, muted peach, honey brown, warm gray shadows. Low contrast and restrained luminosity, not vivid orange or a dramatic blazing fire. Mostly light ivory negative space on the left two thirds for dark readable text. The candles must dissolve softly into the background, not look like cutout stickers or sharp foreground objects. No extra candles, heart symbols, stars, typography, borders, logos, website layout or watermark. Suitable as a subtle background layer, not an attention-grabbing hero illustration.
